data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer – AI Product (m/f/d) | Remote from Croatia
data.description:
Deine Rolle:

Want to do more than just write code?
At Cito, we're building CERA AI – an AI agent that automates real logistics processes: from processing incoming emails and negotiating prices to transferring transport orders.
Real processes. Real customers. Real impact.


Deine Mission bei uns:

  • Take ownership of key parts of our AI and software architecture
  • Design and develop scalable AI agent systems, including multi-step reasoning, decision pipelines and tool use
  • Build and improve our LLM-based systems, including prompting, tooling, memory and orchestration
  • Ensure reliability and quality of AI outputs through evaluation, monitoring and guardrails
  • Build observability and evaluation frameworks, including regression testing for AI systems
  • Work closely with Product and Business to turn real operational problems into scalable technical solutions
  • Make technical decisions with long-term impact on architecture, stack and scalability
  • Ship solutions that are actually used by customers


Damit passt du zu uns:

  • 6–8+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Ideally, hands-on experience building AI/LLM-based products or systems
  • Strong Python skills, ideally with Django or a comparable framework
  • Experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude or similar
  • Understanding of AI system design beyond simply integrating an API
  • Experience with evaluation methods, monitoring and observability
  • Ability to think in systems rather than individual features
  • Strong understanding of the trade-offs between speed, reliability and quality
  • High level of ownership and ability to work independently
  • A pragmatic mindset: you like building, shipping and improving real products
  • Professional working proficiency in English


Darauf kannst du dich freuen:

  • Work 100% remotely from Croatia
    Stay in Croatia – no relocation to Germany required.
    Join a German tech company
    Become part of an international team building technology for the European logistics market.
    Build a real AI product
    This isn't an AI side project or prototype. You'll work on an AI system that automates real business processes for real customers.
    High technical ownership
    We don't want someone who simply works through a backlog. You'll have room to shape architecture, technology and the future of the product.
    Impact over bureaucracy
    We're a fast-moving team where technical decisions don't disappear behind multiple layers of approval.
    Long-term collaboration
    We're looking for someone who wants to become an integral part of our team – not a short-term outsourcing resource.

data.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
data.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

  • Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

  • Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

data.title: Senior Web Engineer (React) - Remote friendly
data.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Web Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Web Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. 

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
